reproducer: node workers/codex/tests/w5a.mjs <host.exe> <initialized-state-template> (38 checks, real pinned app-server + real model); cargo deterministic suite 47 passed / 1 ignored

surface: GET /local/v1/tasks/{id}/context-packages/{pid} (detail; file sources carry base64 `content`, text/summary carry `text`; digestVerified + coverage=FROZEN_AT_CREATION)
observed: file source bytes are copied at creation into context_package_sources; a later workspace rewrite of the same file leaves the package bytes and digest bit-identical (freeze proof)

digest is sha256 over the canonical source set; every source row carries kind/path/sha256/size; detail re-verifies each recorded sha256 against the stored bytes (corruption -> PACKAGE_SOURCE_CHANGED); SQL spot-check confirms durable rows

lexical + realpath checks confine file sources to the task workspace and apply the writeScope denyPaths prefix rule: ../ escapes, absolute outside paths and deny-prefixed paths all refused PACKAGE_SOURCE_OUT_OF_SCOPE; missing or non-file sources -> PACKAGE_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE

bounds enforced at intake: 20 sources/package (20 file-kind max), 256 KiB/source, 64 KiB/text source, 1 MiB/package, 32 packages/task -> all PACKAGE_SOURCE_TOO_LARGE / INVALID_PACKAGE_SOURCES / PACKAGE_LIMIT
same requestKey+body replays the stored package; same key + different body -> 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; context-package.created event durable
limits: packages are immutable once created: no update/append surface is exposed
file sources resolve through the task workspace only; nothing outside it can be packaged

nativeSurface: separate managed codex app-server peer per session on its own CODEX_HOME (task MCP/skills/hooks NOT replicated)
thread/start model=<frozen> cwd=<workspace snapshot> approvalPolicy=never sandbox=read-only
one bounded turn/start per session; turn/interrupt + job-kill stop
thread/tokenUsage/updated feeds an independent usage ledger
observed: real model Q&A answered correctly using ONLY inlined frozen package content (marker token present nowhere else on the aux thread); aux thread id != main thread id

workspace snapshot copied at intake under <state>/auxiliary/<task>/<aux>/workspace (.git and symlinks skipped, bounded 4096 files / 32 MiB -> AUX_SNAPSHOT_TOO_LARGE); aux writes cannot touch the main workspace; snapshot content verified byte-identical while main file diverged afterwards
stop kills only the aux peer; parent task untouched (still SUCCEEDED); durable 4-session cap -> 409 AUX_SESSION_LIMIT; host-wide live cap NWF_CODEX_MAX_ACTIVE_AUX -> 409 AUX_SESSION_BUSY

deliver injects the answer into the MAIN task via the existing follow-up path: same thread, new native turn, generation preserved on live path, currentCommandId=deliver key; aux-session.delivered + turn.bound(requestKey) facts; one-shot atomic deliveredAt mark: second deliver -> 409 AUX_ALREADY_DELIVERED, unfinished session -> AUX_NOT_FINISHED; no aux output enters the main session before delivery

optional budget {maxTotalTokens} enforced SOFT/post-hoc like the parent: a counting prompt with cap 150 settled FAILED with reasonCode BUDGET_EXCEEDED and independent usage; parent usageTotals unchanged
durable deadlineEpochMillis + 1s sweep: an overdue RUNNING session settles CANCELLED with reasonCode AUX_DEADLINE and its peer is released
host restart or HOST_CLOSE: in-flight sessions reconcile CANCELLED with reasonCode HOST_RESTART_JOB_CLOSED / HOST_CLOSE; terminal rows (SUCCEEDED/deliveredAt) survive; no continuation claimed
limits: usage events can arrive before OR after the turn's completion notification on this pin; a crossed cap settles FAILED/BUDGET_EXCEEDED at whichever accounting boundary observes it — the cap can never preempt a model request
aux sessions hold no task-concurrency slot; each is a single bounded turn with no follow-up/steer surface
no aux output reaches the main session except through an explicit deliver
sandbox=read-only is a protocol-level request, not an OS guarantee — isolation is proven by the workspace copy, not claimed as sandbox enforcement (COPY_ISOLATION_NOT_OS_READONLY)

nativeSurface: existing STOP machinery for owner quiescence (turn/interrupt, job-kill drain, terminal settlement, question expiry, effects UNKNOWN) — the pinned protocol has no boundary pause/checkpoint
thread/resume on the same stored nativeSessionId, then turn/start with the fixed continuation
fresh generation + segment + ownerEpoch+1 admitted atomically with the durable transition row, request and both facts; transition ids are tr-*
observed: transition on a LIVE task: host quiesced the owner itself (transition.quiesced method=MANAGED_STOP_QUIESCE alreadyQuiescent=false) then reopened the same native thread under new generation/segmentId/ownerEpoch 1->2; task returned SUCCEEDED

an already-quiesced completed session takes the Path-C route (method=COMPLETED_SESSION) gated by reopen_blockers: SUCCEEDED + quiescent + completedSessionSeal + completed turn seal + no open effects/questions
events transition.quiesced + transition.admitted; the durable transitions listing carries the full compatibility object {engineId,sameEngine:true,crossEngine:false,sameNativeSession:true,method}
incompatible targets refused BEFORE any state change (engineId!=codex, model!=frozen, toolAllowlist set) -> 409 INCOMPATIBLE_TRANSITION; task state and transitions table untouched
stale-owner fencing: a follow-up bound to the pre-transition generation/turn/command -> 409 NATIVE_TARGET_CHANGED
post-restart transitions on an UNKNOWN task -> 409 TRANSITION_STATE_INCOMPATIBLE
limits: same-engine/same-thread only: engineId must be codex and model must equal the task's frozen model
no cross-engine migration — advertised as explicit GAP capability execution.crossEngineTransition
no tool-allowlist change (the pin has no per-turn tool allowlist knob); a requested restriction is refused rather than silently ignored
a live-session quiesce is interrupt+stop, not a quiet boundary checkpoint — the transition.quiesced method names which proof was used (MANAGED_STOP_QUIESCE vs COMPLETED_SESSION)

unchangedGaps: cross-engine thread migration is an explicit GAP by design in W5a
